scale.whole_size_status: Illustrative small gracile sheep-sized body reconstruction, not directly measured articulated skeleton.

uncertainties: 2021 study identifies males by cranial ornamentation and separates female and crushed incomplete male measurements. Do not extrapolate exact full body dimensions from damaged male.
1892 appendage illustrations are original specimen drawings, soft tissue coverage is not directly preserved. Use understated skin-covered shapes without invented horn rings.
Whole-body lengths, tail, ears and coat are conservative reconstruction choices. No copy of other species body mesh or artwork.
Historical paper used Lower Miocene dating; use current Oligocene context from later study rather than historical date terminology.
